maria: Quick sync 1: finalize landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, plus webinar + launch posts. Two-week sprint?
aj: Two weeks works. propose webinar next Wed 10am PT, pre-launch post 48h prior.
noah: I'll deliver three hero artframes + two CTA sets by Fri.
sam: I'll assemble benchmark bullets (p95, tokens/sec, $/k) and a one-page with sample prompt set.
tess: I'll spin up the webinar page + HubSpot form. Confirm routing: mode param maps to tag; hosted -> inbound SDR, dedicated/private -> AE+SE.
maria: Correct. utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch_v3. Gate the deeper latency report as latency-playbook.pdf behind webinar reg.
aj: Hero copy candidates: Hosted: "Hosted API 1 fast to start, easy to scale." Dedicated: "Reserved capacity 1 predictable throughput." Private: "Private deployment 1 enterprise controls"
noah: Subhead: "Same API. Different SLAs."
sam: Benchmark bullets per mode ready for Thursday: hosted median latency + cost; dedicated p95 stability + concurrency; private compliance + KMS.
tess: Form note: add hidden mode field so pages pass mode=hosted|dedicated|private. example: <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"mode\" value=\"dedicated\">
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy window Wed 08:00 PT. Put assets in /releases/marketing by Tue 18:00 PT.
maria: CTA A/B test: Variant A = "Get started 1 Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Request private consult". Variant B = "Try Hosted" / "Talk to sales 1 Dedicated" / "Book private demo". Experiment id: launch_cta_tri_v1.
aj: I'll draft social + post copy Mon.
noah: Upload frames + a11y checklist Tue morning.
sam: One-pager + CSV of benchmark numbers Thu.
tess: Publish page + HubSpot workflow Mon.
maria: Dry-run Mon EOD, final sync Wed 09:00 PT. Thanks team! :rocket:
